name: json-yaml-tools
description: Offline JSON/YAML/TOML toolkit — convert between formats, query with JMESPath, validate against JSON Schema, deep-merge documents, and pretty-print or minify. Runs fully local with no network or credentials.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: data.convert
tools.description: Parse a JSON, YAML, or TOML document and re-emit it as JSON or YAML. TOML is read-only; output to TOML is not supported.

input.description: The document contents as a string. If omitted, provide inputPath.

inputPath.description: Optional path to a file to read the document from instead of input.

tools.name: data.query
tools.description: Run a JMESPath expression against a JSON or YAML document and return the matched result.

input.description: The document contents as a string. If omitted, provide inputPath.

inputPath.description: Optional path to a file to read the document from instead of input.

format.description: Format of the input document (default json)

tools.name: data.validate
tools.description: Validate a JSON or YAML document against a JSON Schema. An invalid document is a normal result (valid:false with errors), not an error.

input.description: The document contents as a string. If omitted, provide inputPath.

inputPath.description: Optional path to a file to read the document from instead of input.

format.description: Format of the input document (default json)

schema.description: The JSON Schema as a JSON string

tools.name: data.merge
tools.description: Deep-merge two or more JSON or YAML documents left-to-right (later inputs win on conflicting scalar keys) and return the merged document in the same format.

inputs.description: Two or more document strings to merge, in precedence order (last wins)

format.description: Format of the inputs and the merged output (default json)

tools.name: data.format
tools.description: Pretty-print or minify a JSON or YAML document.

input.description: The document contents as a string. If omitted, provide inputPath.

inputPath.description: Optional path to a file to read the document from instead of input.

format.description: Format of the input document (default json)

action.description: pretty = indented output; minify = compact output
